components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action of a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0db7ed; color: #00131a; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #0db7ed 88%, white); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0db7ed; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary action next to the filled one.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: transparent; color: #ededed; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 1px solid #454545; border-radius: 0.375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); } .ds-btn-outlined:active { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0db7ed; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Plain navigation action; the current page reads as pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { background: transparent; color: #ededed; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-text:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0db7ed; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Read-only state label: a light, then the word.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #4ade80 22%, transparent); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: #0d2b1b; color: #4ade80; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip::before { content: ''; width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #4ade80; }

components.name: Job Panel
components.description: Hairline panel on the black page with a name, tag, bar and meta line.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-panel { background: #0a0a0a; border: 1px solid #2e2e2e; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; color: #ededed; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font: 600 1.25rem/1.75rem 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-panel-meta { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: #a1a1a1; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Outlined field whose outline lights up in cyan on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; background: transparent; color: #ededed; border: 1px solid #6b6b6b; border-radius: 0.375rem; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.5rem 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #8f8f8f; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0db7ed; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0db7ed; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: 6px track with a cyan fill; green, amber, red or grey by state.
components.css: .ds-track { height: 0.375rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0.125rem; background: #1f1f1f; width: 16rem; } .ds-fill { width: 62%; height: 100%; border-radius: 0.125rem; background: #0db7ed; }

components.name: Segmented Switch
components.description: Frame of two options; the selected one is lit by a 22% cyan highlight.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid #6b6b6b; border-radius: 0.5rem; } .ds-seg-opt { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: none; color: #a1a1a1; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { color: #ededed; } .ds-seg-on { background: color-mix(in srgb, #0db7ed 22%, transparent); color: #0db7ed; font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0db7ed; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
AniLink is a black page with hairline panels for work that carries on by itself. A person pastes a season, sets it going and looks away; the page is what they glance at later, to see which downloads run, which wait for a password and which failed. It is built in the category's own grammar, at the craft level of a professional dashboard: square-ish controls, plain grey surfaces, one signal colour, and nothing that asks to be looked at.

Surfaces are neutral greys in small even steps over a pure black page. A panel is told from the page by its hairline, a row from its panel by one tone. Controls have 6px corners, and only the one action of a view is filled in the brand cyan; every other button is outlined or plain. State is a small light in front of a word, and the word always says it too. Motion confirms a change and stops.

The system is dark only; the owner has confirmed there is no light theme. The interface is in English. The mark is unchanged and shared with the favicon.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, pure black page, neutral grey steps, no tint from the brand hue.
Depth through tone plus a 1px hairline; shadows only for what floats.
One signal colour (brand cyan) for the action, the progress fill, focus and the selected option; four status hues with words.
Corners of 2, 4, 6, 8 and 12px; full pills only for the switch and the scroll bar.
One family, Geist, in 400, 500 and 600, with Geist Mono for links and paths.
Short, decelerating motion that collapses to nothing under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Brand Cyan fills at most one button per view. The others are outlined or plain, so a row of buttons has one thing to press first.

rules.name: The Status Light Rule
rules.body: Colour means state, shown as a 6px light in front of a word. Green, amber and red mean done, attention and failure; a colour is never added for decoration.

rules.name: The Say It Too Rule
rules.body: A state is never told by colour alone. Every chip, notification, activity entry and bar carries the state in a word.

rules.name: The Ink On Cyan Rule
rules.body: Anything laid on Brand Cyan uses Brand Ink.

rules.name: The Dark Only Rule
rules.body: There is no light theme and no light surface. Confirmed by the owner.

rules.name: The Neutral Tint Rule
rules.body: Hover and pressed tints are white at 6% and 10%, never the brand colour, which would read as selected.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes uses tabular figures, so an updating value never shifts its neighbours.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist carries everything except links and paths. Do not add a display or accent typeface.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces by tone and a hairline. A shadow belongs to things that float over the page.

dos: Do take colours from the tokens (--mat-sys-*, --app-*); pick the nearest grey step for a new surface.
Do keep Brand Cyan for the one action, the active progress, focus and the selected option, with Brand Ink on top.
Do put a status light and a word in the same element for every state.
Do use tabular figures for any number that updates.
Do keep controls at 6px corners, 40px high (44px on touch), and rows and panels on the 6px and 8px steps.
Do draw edges with a 1px Hairline and tone; keep shadows for floating things.
Do keep the 2px cyan focus ring visible and every icon-only button labelled.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion for anything that moves.
donts: Don't add a light theme or a light surface.
Don't put white text on Brand Cyan or fill a second button in cyan.
Don't use colour as the only signal of a state, or mark state with a side stripe.
Don't tint greys with the brand hue or let a hover tint use the brand colour.
Don't make pills or large rounded shapes for controls, chips or panels.
Don't add a second typeface or a display size; the page has no hero.
Don't let a card get its edge from a shadow.
